name: Kira
source: An incubus type monster Kira fights against [url=http://vndb.org/c13604]Baron Squid[/url] in his own way by supporting [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] and his allies. Many monster girls are in love with him which makes it hard on Leo whenever he comes to assist him.
